'''2001 German National Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG national championship held in Bochum, Germany on 7 April 2001. [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] won it. It is known from Alexander Schwarz's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2048">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-09-germany-bochum-04-07-01d2048/ germany-bochum-04-07-01], DeckTech (Alexander "Black Leader" Schwarz, 9 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-09-germany-bochum-04-07-01d2048/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 7 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Bochum, Germany
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 53
* '''Winner:''' [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]
